theorems.name: Submission.p06_9e0f5043ff_local_norm_order
theorems.statement: ∀ (K E L : Type*) [Field K] [Field E] [Field L] [Algebra K E] [Algebra K L] [Algebra E L] [IsScalarTower K E L] [FiniteDimensional E L] [Algebra.IsSeparable E L] (v : AlgebraicCurve.Place K E) (f : L), f ≠ 0 → v.ord (Algebra.norm E f) = Finset.sum (v.fiberOver L) (fun w => (w.inertiaDeg E : ℤ) * w.ord f)
theorems.natural_summary: Combines the accepted integral norm-length and fiber-length identities, then extends to nonzero fractions using norm multiplicativity and order additivity.
